title: Real estate services in Barcelona · HousySpace
description: Real estate services in Barcelona: sales, valuation, rentals and management, personal shopper, investment, renovations and legal, tax and financial advice.

items.text: Services
One commitment, many ways to help you.
Owners
Sell, value *or rent out your home*

items.title: Property sales and brokerage
items.text: We guide you through the sale of your home, from the initial assessment and sales strategy to closing the deal.

items.title: Property valuation
items.text: We analyse the market and your property's features to help you work out its value and the right asking price.

items.title: Rentals and property management
items.text: We market your home, screen candidates and, if you need it, manage the rental throughout the lease.
Buyers and investors
Buy *or invest wisely*

items.title: Real estate personal shopper
items.text: We search for and assess homes that match your needs and support you through the purchase, all the way to signing.

items.title: Real estate investment
items.text: We look at investment opportunities, costs, potential returns and risks, so you can decide with confidence.
Specialist advice and solutions
Professional support *for every decision*

items.title: Renovations and interior design
items.text: We coordinate renovation and interior design projects with specialist professionals, from the first quote to handover.

items.title: Legal and tax advice
items.text: We coordinate legal and tax professionals to cover the legal and tax needs of your transaction.

items.title: Financial advice
items.text: We put you in touch with financing specialists and coordinate the mortgage study with your property transaction.
Common situations
You may *be here*

items.title: Do I sell or rent?
items.text: We compare both options with numbers: sale price, expected rent, taxes and costs.

items.title: Do I sell now or wait?
items.text: We look at demand in your area and what changes if you wait.

items.title: I have inherited a home
items.text: Which formalities apply, which taxes you owe and what to do with the property.

items.title: Do I renovate before selling?
items.text: Which improvements can help the sale and which aren't worth it.

items.title: I want to move
items.text: How to coordinate selling yours with buying the new one.

items.title: I want to invest in property
items.text: What to buy, what the numbers look like and what the risks are.
How we help you
Advice *that starts with listening*

Not every real estate decision starts with a sale. Sometimes the first thing is to understand what you need, analyse the possibilities and decide which is the best path. At HousySpace we study each situation to offer you personalised advice, with judgement and without hasty decisions.

items.title: Conversation
items.text: We talk about your situation and what you want to achieve.

items.title: Analysis
items.text: We study the property, the area and the alternatives.

items.title: Roadmap
items.text: We propose the steps, the timings and the costs.

items.title: Guidance
items.text: We help you decide and, if you wish, put it into action.
